resources.string: Logs hardware key presses (e.g. long-pressing volume) for the Walkie-Claudie button test. Keys are passed through unchanged.

Button test. Press keys and watch the log.
• Side key: Settings › Advanced features › Side button › Double press › Open app › "Walkie PTT"
• Volume long-press: enable accessibility service
• Earphone: start background listener, then try with the screen off / another app open
